pages.text: $(bold)Super-Tier Magic$() (comes with Magic Gold tools, $(bold)no levels$())$(br2)Effects:$(li)the tool carries a $(bold)spell container$(), so the $(bold)Arcane Anvil$() accepts it and you can inscribe scroll spells (then pick them from the spell wheel while held or worn)$(li)inscribed spells are cast at $(bold)twice their own level cap$() ('super-tier' = beyond the cap; anything higher stays as it is)$(li)$(bold)3x range$()$(li)$(bold)2x duration$()$(br2)Note: in Iron's Spells both range and duration derive from spell power, so the implementation is 'power x3 -> range x3', then damage and healing are $(bold)divided back$() to their original values and status durations are multiplied by $(bold)2/3$() to land on x2 - so only range and duration grow, and $(bold)damage gets no extra multiplier$() (it only follows the raised level).
